title: Staff Software Engineer - Ingestion
description: P-1403 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Lakeflow Connect team is building the data ingestion foundation for the Databricks Lakehouse. We provide ready-to-use connectors for enterprise applications, databases, cloud storage, and other critical data sources. Our mission is to enable seamless data ingestion across every Databricks surface while minimizing impact on production systems through techniques including incremental data capture and log parsing. This role offers the opportunity to work on core database internals challenges at scale and shape a strategic platform capability that powers Data and AI workflows across the company. The Impact You Will Have - Design and build highly scalable, fault-tolerant data ingestion systems processing hundreds of terabytes daily across thousands of customers. - Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from architecture design through production delivery, working across multiple teams. - Drive technical strategy and influence product roadmap for a key platform capability embedded across Databricks surfaces. - Perform low-level systems debugging, performance measurement, and optimization on large production clusters. - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership as a team lead, including sprint planning and project coordination. - Influence organizational direction and drive engineering initiatives that improve reliability, performance, and customer satisfaction. What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience. - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments. - Deep understanding of database internals, including replication, backup, transaction recovery, or related areas. - Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and their application to real-world systems challenges. - Ability to work toward multi-year technical visions with incremental, customer-focused deliverables. - Experience with one or more programming languages including Java, Scala, C++, or Go. - Track record of driving complex technical projects involving multiple teams and system boundaries. - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
